title: Ruthless. Citadel Theatre. Spring 2026.
transcript: Admit it. It's you who wants to be a star. What? You're jealous of your daughter's talent. I am deliriously happy living a normal, ordinary life. And so, too, will my daughter. A normal life is not possible. Not for a desperate woman who depended on strangers loving her night after night in a dark theatre. I'm quoting you, Encore. It’s a passage from your book: “Hooker on Fame: The Dark Truth about Ruth DelMarco” Oh! Ruth Dalmaco. I don't deny she had talent, but that woman was insane. Imagine k*lling yourself over a bad review. A review written by Lita Encore. Your bad review closed her show. But for your vicious words, Ruth DelMarco would still be alive. Perhaps she is. Excuse me? Well, they never found her body. Just those big footprints in the sand and a suicide note. “Goodbye, cruel world.” Three words, two of which were misspelled. And as for k*lling Ruth Del Marco. Do you deny that three years ago Ruth Del Marco was spotted doing. “I Do, I Do” in Bucks County? That was just a rumour. Perhaps, but they never found her body. Oh, her child. There was a child. Another rumor. Does Ruth Del Marco have a child? A little girl, I believe. Who wants lunch? I'll help you out. Coming, Tina! Mommy's starving. She kept it quiet,of course. I don't think anyone knew who the father was. Oh, mother! Bob Fosse! But you didn't hear it from me!
